messages:
Lina (People Ops): Quick heads-up — candidate for SDE II (Eva K) requested 30m extra time for the on-site exercise on Thu 11:00am PT. I updated the invite: https://cal.event/xyz :spiral_calendar:
Matt (Eng): ok — I can stay an extra 30m after the panel to cover.
Oliver (Eng): I can scribe if needed, but reminder I have another 1pm call. fine to swap with Matt if he wants to lead.
Priya (Hiring Manager): Thanks Lina. Can we also confirm rubric weights? For this role I'd like technical (coding + design) 60, systems thinking 25, communication/culture 15.
Lina (People Ops): noted — would you like that added to the debrief template so reviewers have anchors?
Priya (Hiring Manager): Yes please. Add short anchors: coding pass/fail criteria, 2 example follow-ups for systems thinking, and a quick 1-5 scale definition.
Matt (Eng): small ask: can we explicitly call out who will grade the coding part vs systems? avoids double-counting. I can take coding. Oliver you ok for systems thinking?
Oliver (Eng): yep I can take systems. I'll use the debrief template.
Lina (People Ops): cool — assigning scribe and grading owners: /assign scribe @Oliver, /assign coding-owner @Matt. Also noted 30m accommodation on calendar.
people-ops-bot: Calendar invite updated by Lina — new end time 12:30pm PT, added note: "+30m accommodation approved".
Priya (Hiring Manager): Quick rubric anchors example (short):
```
Coding (60)
- 5: Correct, efficient, clear algorithm, edge cases handled
- 3: Correct but some inefficiencies or missed edge cases
- 1: Wrong approach or major gaps

Systems (25)
- Prompted follow-ups: scaling, failure modes, data consistency

Communication (15)
- 5: clear tradeoffs, explains reasoning, asks clarifying q's
```
Lina (People Ops): perfect. Oliver — can you capture notes into the hiring drive doc after the call? Link is in the invite. If something changes ping here.
Oliver (Eng): will do.
Matt (Eng): one more thing — candidate is in GMT+1. Confirming test environment access is already pre-provisioned? 
Lina (People Ops): yes, infra checklist done by infra-team yesterday. I also DM'ed infra with the candidate timezone.
Priya (Hiring Manager): Last call: if anyone needs to swap, please shout here by EOD Wed so we can reassign scribe. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Lina (People Ops): thanks — tagging for visibility @channel :slightly_smiling_face:
